text:
maria: Kicking off region-by-region rollforward for v2.4.1. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Need capacity OKs and pin agreements. Release notes: https://intra.redwood.com/releases/v2.4.1 :rocket:

oliver: ack. I'll run quick capacity sweep now and post numbers.

deploy-bot: Rollout plan generated for v2.4.1
- slices: 10%, 30%, 100%
- regions: us, eu, apac
- fallback: v2.4.0
Command: `deployctl start --release v2.4.1 --strategy=regional-staged`

kevin: US (us-east-1) capacity: GPUs free 72 / 100, avg p99 latency 42ms, headroom for 3x slice. No quota alarms.

sre-bot: EU (eu-west-1) quota usage 88% -> recommend reduce initial slice to 5% and monitor. Alert rule: quota_util > 90% triggers notify.

tara: If EU spikes, plan is to pin eu routes to v2.4.0 and open rollback window 10m. Are we ok with that? :thinking:

jun: agree with tara. I'll prepare routing pin script. If EU > 90% or p95 latency > 300ms rollback by pin. Script:
```
routectl pin --region=eu --version=v2.4.0 --reason="rollback-eu-surge"
```

ops-liaison: Notifying customer success and sales about the window. I'll include canned message and escalation list.

maria: Final decisions:
- US: start 10% -> 30 after 8m if stable
- EU: start 5% -> 15 if metrics ok, pin plan ready
- APAC: hold until EU stable, then start 10%
Rollback triggers: EU quota > 90% OR region p95 latency > 300ms OR error rate > 1.5%
Everyone ok? :thumbsup:

oliver: ok from infra. I'll be on call for the US and EU slices.

kevin: I'll watch APAC warmup; have reserved burst capacity if we need to absorb traffic.

maria: great. I'll kick the deploy at T+10m. Will post updates in this thread. Thanks all.
